body: welcome to zCup's Random Mod! I had some friends and some people in my youtube comment section help on this project. The main idea of this mod is to add a bunch of stuff that doesn't need to be in Minecraft but it's not too horrible items. Coal armor and coal tools, emerald armor and emerald tools, new ores such as a Chicken Jockey ore and more!! A LOT of stuff will be added to this soon but I need more ideas so either tell me on YouTube or here in the comments
